rows.contract: Frontend presents either a valid native surface or an explicit headless mode.
rows.native_mapping: Use frontend-neutral retained CAMetalLayer handle; headless is a valid published state. Keep non-Apple platform-specific surface dispatch outside this native path.
rows.expected_result: Compile source-compatible C++ consumer and run native headless/attach fixture.
rows.actual_result: Native arm64 C++20 and Objective-C++ ARC consumer builds, device-free exact odd/Retina extent, clamping and headless semantics, neutral dependency closure, PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 plus 5 skips.

rows.contract: Mac native path consumes the exact CAMetalLayer associated with a render view.
rows.native_mapping: Own main-thread attach/detach; adopt a real layer or install and restore an owned replacement, with no copied unowned native pointer crossing the frontend boundary.
rows.expected_result: AppKit fixture validates real layer/host lifetime, invalid handle and stale replacement.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Native surface type and presentation availability are distinct from GPU/device selection.
rows.native_mapping: Propagate surface visible/size state, fullscreen and refresh independently through the existing snapshot contract. Reserve device/Metal4 validation for existing Instance.
rows.expected_result: Verify unpublished/windowless/suspended/resumed cases and native shape.
rows.actual_result: Native arm64 C++20 and Objective-C++ ARC consumer builds, device-free exact odd/Retina extent, clamping and headless semantics, neutral dependency closure, PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 plus 5 skips.

rows.contract: Backend capability errors are explicit instead of returning invalid handles.
rows.native_mapping: Reject invalid host objects/geometry before mutating native state and reject off-main access. Distinguish headless from failed capture.
rows.expected_result: Deterministic off-main and failed input checks in actual implementation.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.
